objective.statement: Evaluate whether to replace the hand-rolled rate limiter in src/middleware/rateLimit.ts with a token-bucket library, comparing at most three candidates on throughput, memory, and API fit, and deliver a written recommendation.
objective.success_definition: A written recommendation is delivered that states whether to replace the hand-rolled rate limiter in src/middleware/rateLimit.ts with a token-bucket library, supported by a comparison of at most three candidates on throughput, memory, and API fit, with no code produced.

goals.statement: Determine whether the hand-rolled rate limiter in src/middleware/rateLimit.ts should be replaced with a token-bucket library.
acceptance: The analysis explicitly concludes whether or not to replace the hand-rolled rate limiter in src/middleware/rateLimit.ts with a token-bucket library.

goals.statement: Compare at most three token-bucket library candidates on throughput, memory, and API fit.
acceptance: No more than three candidates are compared.
The comparison addresses throughput, memory, and API fit for each candidate.

goals.statement: Deliver the outcome as a written recommendation, not code.
acceptance: The deliverable is a written recommendation.
No code is produced as part of the deliverable.

constraints.statement: At most three token-bucket library candidates may be compared.
The deliverable must be a written recommendation, not code.

non_goals.statement: Writing, modifying, or shipping code; the task explicitly calls for a written recommendation, not code.

include: src/middleware/rateLimit.ts (the existing hand-rolled rate limiter under evaluation)
Comparison of at most three token-bucket library candidates on throughput, memory, and API fit

deliverables.description: A written recommendation on whether to replace the hand-rolled rate limiter in src/middleware/rateLimit.ts with a token-bucket library, based on a comparison of at most three candidates on throughput, memory, and API fit.

factors: The task is analysis-only; it explicitly excludes code changes, so nothing in the running system is modified.
